summary.text: TREND SKO ARKADEN AS is a private limited company registered in Skien, founded 1987-10-21. TREND SKO ARKADEN AS is engaged in shoe retail. Its purpose is the buying and selling of footwear, investing in other companies and enterprises, and other business connected with this. It was previously named SKOBUTIKKEN COMANCHE AS until 2000-08-02. Its main industry code is 47.720: retail sale of footwear and leather goods. The register shows 18 employees and 3 registered workplaces.
